headline: O'Brien Brothers seeks attached garages for 17 Hillside homes at 500 Old Farm Road, dropping one home.
summary: The new SF-11 home, about 2,500 square feet, would be added on Eastview Lane and Lot 36. On Lot 36, one of five small cottage homes would be dropped, and the applicant said none of the cottages have sold since they went on sale in 2023. The board closed the hearing and said it will be in touch later. The board also continued the Green Mountain Habitat for Humanity site plan at 1720 Spear Street to January 5, 2027.
decisions: Continued the Green Mountain Habitat for Humanity site plan at 1720 Spear Street to January 5, 2027.
discussion: Garages and yards: Members discussed losing detached garages and the lawn space behind homes on Eastview Lane. Some said nearby shared green space could offset that, and the board plans a condition on mirrored or alternating layouts where attached homes sit side by side, unless grading requires otherwise.
Home height on Lot 32: Members said some homes would sit higher above Old Farm Road than in the record plans. The applicant said grading changes were needed so driveways slope toward the alley.
Minor amendment: Members agreed the change still fits a minor amendment. They said the lots, roads, and general home types stay the same, and one home is removed.

Housing sizes and mix: The applicant said plans range from 1,256 to 3,500 square feet, and the median home across 170 homes is 1,898 square feet. The applicant also said the townhome and single-family split stays about 60/40.

decision_evidence.quote: So, I make a motion to continue this hearing to January 5th, 2027. Seconded. Uh, great. All those in favor? Aye. Aye. Any opposed? Abstain? Okay, motion carries.
